title: Quote Block
content: Create styled quote/blockquote components. Blockquote: border-left accent, italic text, citation below. Pull quote: large decorative quote, centered. Testimonial: quote with author photo and attribution. Quote marks: decorative opening/closing quote marks. Colors: accent color for border or quote marks. Author: name, title, company, optional photo. Icons: quote icon decoration. Card variant: boxed quote with shadow. Twitter style: quote card matching tweet appearance. Responsive: adjust font sizes for mobile.

variants.simple: Style blockquotes and pull quotes attractively.
variants.detailed: Create styled quote/blockquote components. Blockquote: border-left accent, italic text, citation below. Pull quote: large decorative quote, centered. Testimonial: quote with author photo and attribution. Quote marks: decorative opening/closing quote marks. Colors: accent color for border or quote marks. Author: name, title, company, optional photo. Icons: quote icon decoration. Card variant: boxed quote with shadow. Twitter style: quote card matching tweet appearance. Responsive: adjust font sizes for mobile.
variants.advanced: Create styled quote and testimonial components. Blockquote style: border-l-4 border-gray-300 pl-4 italic text-gray-700, citation as footer with author name. Pull quote: large text-2xl or text-3xl, centered, optional decorative quote marks, different font-weight or font-style. Quote marks decoration: absolute positioned large quote characters (text-6xl text-gray-200) at top-left and bottom-right, or using ::before/::after pseudo-elements. Testimonial card: avatar (rounded-full), quote text, author name (font-semibold), title/company (text-gray-500), optional star rating. Card variants: simple with border, elevated with shadow-lg, filled background (bg-gray-50), gradient accent. Colors: customizable accent for border or quote marks, brand colors for testimonials. Icon decoration: Quote icon from lucide-react as large watermark or inline accent. Tweet/social style: card resembling embedded tweet with author, text, date, platform icon. Attribution line: em dash followed by Author Name, Title at Company (styled consistently). Responsive: base text sizes scale down on mobile, quote marks may hide or shrink. Slider/carousel: multiple testimonials rotating, with navigation dots. Grid layout: testimonial grid for social proof sections. Animation: subtle fade-in on scroll into view. Accessibility: blockquote element for semantic quote, cite element for attribution.
